title: Your shifts
endBody: How long was your unpaid break?
manualHint: Shifts you add yourself are marked “Added by you”. Times are India time.

errors.alreadyOpen: You already have a shift running.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end time must be after the start time.
errors.tooLong: A shift can be at most 24 hours. Please ask your supervisor to correct it.
errors.inFuture: The start time cannot be in the future.
errors.breakTooLong: The break must be shorter than the shift.
